epics.title: Core Ingestion Pipeline Setup
epics.description: Establish the foundational worker, database schema, and API for receiving Gmail data.

tasks.title: Initialize Cloudflare Worker Project
tasks.description: Set up a new Cloudflare Worker project using Wrangler, including basic configuration and environment setup.
steps: Run `wrangler init` to create the project structure.
Configure `wrangler.toml` with necessary bindings for D1, R2, and Queues.
Set up environment variables for database names and bucket names.
tasks.success_criteria: The worker can be deployed to Cloudflare and responds to a basic health check endpoint.

tasks.title: Define and Migrate D1 Database Schema
tasks.description: Create and apply the initial D1 database schema for messages, threads, and attachments.
steps: Write SQL migration scripts for `messages`, `threads`, and `attachments` tables.
Add a `vectorization_status` column to messages and attachments.
Run migrations using `wrangler d1 migrations apply`.
tasks.success_criteria: The database schema is successfully applied to the D1 database and can be inspected.
tasks.unit_test_criteria: Write a test script to connect to the database and verify that all tables and columns exist as expected.

tasks.title: Implement Secure Ingestion API Endpoint
tasks.description: Build the main `/api/v1/messages` endpoint to handle incoming email data.
steps: Parse the incoming JSON payload containing email data.
Develop logic to differentiate between large and small attachments based on a size field in the payload.
tasks.success_criteria: The endpoint correctly receives data, validates the API key, and processes the payload without errors.
tasks.unit_test_criteria: Create unit tests that simulate valid and invalid API calls to the endpoint.

tasks.title: Implement R2 Signed URL Generation
tasks.description: Create the `/api/v1/attachments/upload-url` endpoint to provide secure, short-lived URLs for direct R2 uploads.
steps: Use the Cloudflare R2 client library to generate a presigned POST URL.
Return the signed URL and required fields to the client.
Implement a callback endpoint `/api/v1/attachments/upload-complete` to be called by the client after upload.
tasks.success_criteria: The endpoint generates a valid signed URL that can be used to upload a file to R2.
tasks.unit_test_criteria: Write a test that calls the endpoint, receives a URL, and simulates a file upload.

tasks.title: Implement Queue Integration
tasks.description: Integrate Cloudflare Queues to send notifications to the AI Agent worker when new data is ready for processing.
steps: After successfully processing an email and its attachments, construct a JSON message containing the `message_id` and `attachment_ids`.
Use the queue client to send the message to the `EMAIL_QUEUE`.
tasks.success_criteria: A message is successfully published to the queue after an email is ingested.
tasks.unit_test_criteria: Mock the queue binding and verify that the `send` method is called with the correct payload.
